identitySignals: Agenda names the Regents of the University of California (Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory) and an Ernest Orlando Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory Cooperative Research and Development Agreement; Berkeley Lab is a University of California-administered laboratory in Berkeley, CA (Wikipedia, lbl.gov UC partnership page)
Berkeley Lab is located in Berkeley and Oakland, CA, in the same area as OUSD
Oakland Public Education Fund page says Berkeley Lab has been an Adopt an Oakland School partner, bringing STEM activities to Oakland classrooms, so it has a documented relationship with OUSD schools
research.notes: The vendor in the agenda is the Regents of the University of California acting for Berkeley Lab; the legal contracting entity is UC, so no separate EIN or CA entity number is given. Legal name left null because no cited page states it exactly.

profile.summary: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (Berkeley Lab) is a federally funded research and development center in Berkeley, California. It is sponsored by the U.S. Department of Energy and administered by the University of California. Its research focuses on discovery science and solutions for energy supplies.

sources.title: Building Pathways to STEM - Oakland Public Education Fund

review.notes: The agenda names Regents of the University of California acting for Ernest Orlando Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, which is the lab profiled; Wikipedia confirms FFRDC, DOE sponsorship and UC administration, lbl.gov confirms the research focus, phone, address and website, and the Oakland Ed Fund page shows an existing OUSD relationship. The profile is neutral and describes the lab, not the Regents as a whole.
